create_emg_recording: create an EmgRecording from an HDF5 file to read EMG timeseries data and prompts
build_windowed_emg_dataset: build a WindowedEmgDataset with strided windows of EMG data from an HDF5 recording
build_handwriting_emg_dataset: build a HandwritingEmgDataset with padded EMG windows aligned to handwriting prompts
create_data_split_from_csv: create a DataSplit object with train val and test partitions from a CSV file
make_concatenated_emg_dataset: make a ConcatDataset of WindowedEmgDataset instances from specified dataset partitions and transforms
